# MarkdownEditor > Compose Markdown with draggable blocks, tables, slash commands, people mentions, formatting, and application-owned image uploads. Choose a rich-text or live-preview engine. Status: beta. This file matches the installed `markdown-editor` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version. ## Install ```bash npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/markdown-editor.json ``` With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/markdown-editor.md`. ## npm dependencies - `@base-ui/react@^1.9.0` - `@tiptap/core@3.35.0` - `@tiptap/extension-image@3.35.0` - `@tiptap/extension-list@3.35.0` - `@tiptap/extension-paragraph@3.35.0` - `@tiptap/extension-table@3.35.0` - `@tiptap/markdown@3.35.0` - `@tiptap/pm@3.35.0` - `@tiptap/react@3.35.0` - `@tiptap/starter-kit@3.35.0` ## Registry dependencies - `checkbox` - `core` - `markdown-editor-parts` - `typography` ## Exports - `@/components/control-ui/markdown-editor`: `MarkdownEditor`, `MarkdownEditorContent`, types `MarkdownEditorContentProps`, `MarkdownEditorStatus`, `MarkdownEditorProps` - `@/components/control-ui/markdown-editor/rich/blocks`: `createRichBlocks` - `@/components/control-ui/markdown-editor/rich/engine`: `pasteMarkdown`, `createRichEngine` - `@/components/control-ui/markdown-editor/rich/extensions`: `ImageUpload`, `markdownExtensions`, `createMarkdownCodec`, `requiresMarkdownSource`, `hasMarkdownContent`, types `MarkdownExtensionOptions` - `@/components/control-ui/markdown-editor/rich/tables`: `createRichTables` - `@/components/control-ui/markdown-editor/rich/task-item`: `MarkdownTaskItem` - `@/components/control-ui/markdown-editor/rich/uploads`: `createRichUploads` ## Composition ### Markdown composition Markdown strings stay application-owned. Both alternatives share these parts. Content includes block drag handles (Alt+ArrowUp/ArrowDown also moves blocks) and table grips for moving, aligning, inserting, and deleting rows and columns. Suggestions adds slash commands and accepts people with persistent profile URLs; mentions save as Markdown links. Supply onUploadImage to enable image paste and drop. isUrlAllowed changes which link and image URLs stay editable (a file-based editor can accept relative links). Rich text renders a TipTap document and normalizes the Markdown it saves. Live preview edits the Markdown text itself, so what you type is what you save. Pass extensions to add editor extensions after the built-in set: TipTap extensions for Rich text, CodeMirror extensions for Live preview, where each table cell gets them too. Both props are read once, when the editor mounts. ```tsx ``` ### Selection bubble menu Use MarkdownEditorBubbleMenu instead of, or alongside, MarkdownEditorToolbar. It appears above non-empty text selections outside code blocks and reuses the toolbar's text style, mark, and link controls; pass children to append custom controls. ```tsx ``` ## Usage ```tsx "use client"; import { useId, useState } from "react"; import { MarkdownEditor, MarkdownEditorContent } from "@/components/control-ui/markdown-editor"; import { MarkdownEditorBubbleMenu } from "@/components/control-ui/markdown-editor/bubble-menu"; import { MarkdownEditorSuggestions } from "@/components/control-ui/markdown-editor/suggestions"; import { MarkdownEditorToolbar, MarkdownEditorUploads } from "@/components/control-ui/markdown-editor/toolbar"; import { Label } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/label"; import { Markdown } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/markdown"; import { Switch } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/switch"; import { Text } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/typography"; const people = [ { id: "alex", label: "Alex Morgan", href: "/people/alex", description: "Design" }, { id: "sam", label: "Sam Rivera", href: "/people/sam", description: "Engineering" }, { id: "jordan", label: "Jordan Lee", href: "/people/jordan", description: "Product" }, ]; const initialMarkdown = "## Project feedback\n\nWe need **clearer feedback** on the new dashboard.\n\n- [x] Describe the issue\n- [ ] Add a screenshot\n\n> Keep the next step easy to find."; export function MarkdownEditorExample() { const [value, setValue] = useState(initialMarkdown); return (
Type / for blocks or @ to mention someone. Drag the handle beside a block to reorder it.
); } export function MarkdownEditorBubbleMenuExample() { const [value, setValue] = useState(initialMarkdown); return (
Select text to format it, type / for blocks, or @ to mention someone.
); } export function MarkdownEditorReadOnlyExample() { const [value, setValue] = useState(initialMarkdown); const [locked, setLocked] = useState(true); const lockId = useId(); return (
{locked ? "Read-only content stays selectable and focusable, so it can be copied and read by assistive technology." : "Unlocked. Edit the description, then lock it again."}
); } ``` ## Anatomy Scopes, their parts, and the state attributes each part carries. Selector pattern: `[data-skin="{skin}"] :where([data-slot="{part}"][data-control-family="{family}"])`. - `markdown-editor` - `content` - `task-checkbox` - `task-content` - `task-item` ## Knobs Registered `--cui-*` custom properties with their recipe defaults. Set them through the component's `style` prop or a skin. ### markdown-editor - `--cui-markdown-editor-background`: `var(--background)` - `--cui-markdown-editor-foreground`: `var(--foreground)` - `--cui-markdown-editor-border-color`: `var(--border)` - `--cui-markdown-editor-focus-border-color`: `var(--focus-rim)` - `--cui-markdown-editor-radius`: `var(--radius-panel)` - `--cui-markdown-editor-padding`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 4)` - `--cui-markdown-editor-gutter-size`: `var(--control-h-xs)` - `--cui-markdown-editor-min-height`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 32)` - `--cui-markdown-editor-max-height`: `60dvh` - `--cui-markdown-editor-gap`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 3)` - `--cui-markdown-editor-muted-foreground`: `var(--muted-foreground)` - `--cui-markdown-editor-code-background`: `var(--muted)` - `--cui-markdown-editor-border-width`: `var(--control-rim-width)` - `--cui-markdown-editor-table-border-width`: `var(--control-rim-width)` - `--cui-markdown-editor-table-border-color`: `var(--border)` - `--cui-markdown-editor-table-selection-background`: `var(--active-fill)` ### label - `--cui-label-root-foreground`: `var(--foreground)` ## Links - Online docs (latest release): https://control-ui.dev/kits/markdown-editor - Anatomy contract: https://control-ui.dev/r/contract/markdown-editor.json
